messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: svc-inference-prod (edge) - error-rate spike > 8% for 10m. Pager owner: @elena
elena: I'm on it, joining prod now. pulling logs from node-3
devon: taking secondary, will look at routing and kvcache stats
elena: seeing 504s and downstream grpc errors. quick grep:
```
2026-03-17T12:11:02Z svc-inference-prod node-3 ERROR upstream: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```
matt: tagging infra oncall @tj - could be network blip to model-hosts
tj: I see increased retransmits on cluster-east-2, overlay fabric shows flaps around 12:08-12:12
sarah: Customer impact: a handful of high-traffic tenants experienced degraded responses ~12:08-12:18. CS alerted; estimating ~2.3k failed requests, ~0.05% of daily traffic
elena: mitigation: disabled cross-region routing fallback for edge pool to keep traffic local. rolling restart node-3 now.
devon: also purged KV prefix for recent heavy prefixes to reduce cache thrash: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "kvcache:prefix:*" | xargs redis-cli DEL`
matt: restart complete on node-3, error-rate falling to 0.6%
incident-bot: Pager resolved. Severity: sev3. Duration: ~12 minutes. Creating post-incident thread for follow-up.
elena: recommend postmortem + action items. Owners: @devon (kvcache tuning), @tj (network fabric), @sarah (customer comms)
devon: quick notes on sizing:
- kvcache tuning (investigate TTL/eviction): 1 engineer, 2d to prototype config, 1w to rollout canary
- implement cache metrics + alerting: 1 engineer, 3d
tj: network fabric deep-dive: 2 engineers, 3d investigation, 1w remediation window depending on vendor support
sarah: customer follow-up: prepare summary and credits decision: 0.5d
matt: Product/ops tie-in: need to map these into Q2 remediation sprint. Severity mapping suggests medium priority but affects multiple tenants so push to sprint-1 for Q2
elena: propose action items and rough JIRA labels:
- RD-INC-1321 investigate-KV-eviction (owner: devon) estimate: 3 story points
- RD-INC-1322 add-kvcache-metrics (owner: devon) estimate: 5 story points
- RD-INC-1323 network-fabric-postmortem (owner: tj) estimate: 8 story points
- RD-INC-1324 customer-comm-summary (owner: sarah) estimate: 1 story point
- RD-INC-1325 postmortem-doc (owner: elena) estimate: 2 story points
devon: agree with estimates, will split RD-INC-1322 into infra/agent tasks if needed
sarah: I'll draft customer note and share in #customer-success for review, aiming EOD
matt: PM alignment: tagging @product-bot to slot RD-INC tasks into Q2 sprint-1 backfill. If any task blocks ship, flag as P0 in roadmap board.
product-bot: Noted. Tentatively scheduling RD-INC-1321/1322 in sprint-1 (Q2 week 1). RD-INC-1323 pending vendor ETA.
elena: scheduling a postmortem meeting: Wed 2026-03-19 10:00am PT. Invite: elena, devon, tj, sarah, matt, infra lead
devon: will attach logs and a short eval prompt set to confirm regressions before/after cache change
tj: I'll add network graphs and vendor ticket link
elena: action owners please add acceptance criteria and rollback plan to each JIRA. Mark severity as Sev3 in ticket metadata.
matt: quick decision table for prioritization (for PMs):
- customer scope: multiple tenants => medium-high
- recurrence risk: medium (kvcache thrash) => schedule in Q2 sprint-1
- effort: moderate => fit into 2-week sprint with 2 engineers
sarah: +1 on sprint-1. I'll prepare comms after postmortem notes are ready.
elena: thanks everyone. I'll own postmortem doc and close loop on action item tracking. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Postmortem thread created: RD-PM-431122. Follow-ups assigned to owners above. Last update recorded.
